vulnerable_statements.reason: The shadow BO's TTM resource can be NULL (e.g. the BO was evicted or its backing was released, which TTM allows). The code dereferences shadow->tbo.resource without checking it, so a NULL pointer dereference can happen during GPU reset / VRAM recovery.
The parent BO's resource is also dereferenced without a NULL check, so the same NULL pointer dereference can happen if the parent has no backing resource.

suggested_fix: Before reading mem_type/start, check that shadow->tbo.resource (and shadow->parent->tbo.resource) are non-NULL. If either is NULL, skip the BO with 'continue', the same way evicted BOs are skipped. For example: if (!shadow->tbo.resource || shadow->tbo.resource->mem_type != TTM_PL_TT || ... || !shadow->parent->tbo.resource || shadow->parent->tbo.resource->mem_type != TTM_PL_VRAM) continue;
